chunks: about the crescent: when the people all see it and agree that it is for two nights, is that permissible?

key_terms.الْعِيصُ: Al-ʿĪṣ, the narrator asking the question
key_terms.الْقَوْمُ: the group of people who saw the crescent
key_terms.الْهِلالِ: the new crescent moon used for determining the lunar month
key_terms.لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ: that it belonged to the second night, not the first

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to rely on a group's agreement that the crescent is already two nights old?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning establishing the moon's sighting for fasting. It indicates that when a group collectively sees the crescent and agrees that it is already in its second night, such a determination is acceptable.
